title: Critique: inner experience cannot build outer physical objects

statements.text: Experiential properties are accessible only to their subject, while mass and charge are observer-independent. Albahari argues it is incoherent for inward-facing experiential properties of micro-subjects to constitute outward-facing physical objects, and Aleksiev doubts spacetime and the quantum state can be grounded in consciousness at all.

sources.quote: Albahari argues that it is incoherent to suppose that facts about the 'inner-facing' experiential properties of micro-level subjects could somehow constitute the 'outer-facing' observer-independent objects
